prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” painter for every project, but **SNL Painting** looks like a strong all-around option to start with: it serves the St. Louis metro, offers interior painting and drywall repair, and reports a 4.9 rating across hundreds of reviews. It’s based in St. Charles, so confirm it serves your address.

I’d also get quotes from **Better Painting** and **Malone Painting**. Both advertise interior work in the area and have strong review or credential claims; Malone also lists PCA membership and BBB accreditation.

Before choosing, compare at least three **written, itemized estimates**. Ask about prep and repairs, paint brand and number of coats, crew and schedule, cleanup, insurance, and warranty. Ratings and credentials can change, so verify them directly and check recent reviews for work similar to yours.

Sources: [SNL Painting](https://snlpainting.com/service/interior-painting-services/), [Better Painting](https://betterpainting.com/services/interior-painting/), [Malone Painting](https://malonepainting.com/about-malone-painting/)
